method: Started from 5,839 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36 hours. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge of about −2.5 or better and no flags, one per game, and checked them against today's 193 newly collected expert picks and Polymarket top-trader positions. A leg stayed only if at least two of top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete matchup/injury reasoning agreed, with nothing disagreeing. Dropped for conflicts: Rockets ML (five outlets and $12k of top-trader money on Houston, but Covers has Denver and Sengun is a game-time decision); Suns ML (three outlets, but top traders back Utah); Pistons −7.5 and Lakers −14.5 (experts on the favourite, top traders against); Aston Villa ML and Procházka ML (two picks each, top traders on the other side); Duke ML vs Clemson (Predictem on Duke, top traders against); Tennessee +1.5 (three outlets, top traders on LSU); Wyoming +7.5 (three outlets, but VegasInsider has New Mexico and Wyoming's QB is doubtful) and its Under (top traders on the Over); Notre Dame −20.5 (Covers has SMU); Bulls/Wizards, Xavier/Iowa and Ohio State/Nebraska (experts split). NHL had no published picks yet and Saturday's NBA/NCAAB previews weren't out, so the ladder leans on Friday night plus Saturday college football and Premier League.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge about −0.1 to −2.5¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.game: Oklahoma State Cowboys @ Minnesota Golden Gophers
ladder.label: Minnesota Golden Gophers
ladder.why: Minnesota is 5-0, winning by about 23 points a game, shoots 52.6% from the floor and holds opponents to 24.6% from three (21st in adjusted defense). Five outlets back the Gophers; the risk is Oklahoma State's 43% three-point shooting.

sources.name: Action Network (via Yahoo) / Ryan Minion (Minnesota ML)

ladder.label: Iowa State Cyclones +1.5
ladder.why: VSiN expects a sloppy, rainy game and notes UCF QB Barnett is banged up (11 sacks taken in the last three games). Top-trader money on this line is all on Iowa State.

ladder.game: Texas Tech Red Raiders @ Baylor Bears
ladder.label: Texas Tech Red Raiders −3.5
ladder.why: Texas Tech has scored 52+ in each of its last three games, while Baylor lost 17-6 at home to TCU as a favourite and keeps stalling in the red zone. Predictem projects 31-24 Tech; WR Kenny Johnson's status is the thing to check.

sources.name: Sports Betting Dime / Ryan Potts (Texas Tech ML)

ladder.label: Under 45.5
ladder.why: Tennessee's defense held Kentucky and Texas A&M to 13 combined points and plays slow and run-first; LSU's offense has been held under 22 in its last two. Two outlets take the Under 45.5.

sources.name: Sports Betting Dime / Juan Pablo Aravena (Under 45.5)

ladder.label: Under 2.5
ladder.why: Arsenal (9-0-1) have conceded a league-low 5 goals with 7 clean sheets in 10, and 5 of the last 6 meetings went under 2.5. Saka is out and Dowman suspended; both previews predict a low-scoring Arsenal win (1-0, 0-2).

ladder.label: Atlanta Hawks
ladder.why: Charlotte is without Knueppel, Grayson Allen, Schroder and Grant Williams, is 1-6 on the road, and lost to Atlanta 128-81 last month. Top-trader money is entirely on Atlanta.

ladder.label: Manchester City
ladder.why: City have lost three league games in a row, but Fulham have lost 20 straight to them and their last 12 at the Etihad. Three previews take City, and top-trader money leans City ($1.7k for vs $1.1k against).

ladder.game: Tulsa Golden Hurricane @ Mississippi State Bulldogs
ladder.label: Mississippi State Bulldogs
ladder.why: Mississippi State already won at UCF and has the rebounding edge; Tulsa's unbeaten start came in four home games. Two outlets back the Bulldogs.

ladder.game: Georgia Bulldogs @ Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets
ladder.label: Georgia Bulldogs
ladder.why: Georgia scores 86.8 a game and won 78-70 at North Carolina; Georgia Tech's 5-0 start came against a soft schedule in a rebuild under Scott Cross. Three outlets take Georgia.

ladder.game: New Orleans Pelicans @ Oklahoma City Thunder
ladder.label: Oklahoma City Thunder
ladder.why: New Orleans is on a back-to-back without Dejounte Murray and Mathurin, with Trey Murphy III questionable, and makes the fewest threes in the league. OKC is missing Holmgren and Jalen Williams, but three outlets still back the Thunder (Predictem projects 121-106).
